methodology.complete_rule: All mathematical conclusions of a numbered result are covered by compiled explicit overlay representations or verified exact historical specialization. methodology.workload_rule: Exactly the same 19 blocks and 105 weighted units as batches 9 and 10; acquired proof and integration effort across the entire article and companion, not Lean declaration counts, line counts, hours or probability of correctness. methodology.literature_boundary: Same scope convention as batch 9: source-faithful explicit literature premises may support a complete relative formalization. They are not internally proved here and are never counted as internally proved theorems.
methodology.unverified_reuse: Names found without a checked sufficient signature receive only component/presumed credit, not complete status.
methodology.validation_scope: Independent source/signature reviews, coordinated global build and exhaustive source/kernel audit; exact publication and remote check outcomes recorded separately.
